GRE Tunnel Resource Validate And Get Available Internal IP Ranges
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/greTunnels/availableInternalIpRanges

Gets the next available GRE tunnel internal IP address ranges.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
internalIpRange
string

Internal IP range information.

staticIp
string

Static IP information.

limit
int32

The maximum number of GRE tunnel IP ranges that can be added.

Default value: 10
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
startIPAddress
string

Starting IP address in the range

endIPAddress
string

Ending IP address in the range

]
